stem:
Qadir stands at the same small distance in front of three mirrors. The diagram summarises the image of his face in each mirror.

Which identification is correct?

options.text: P is plane, Q is concave, R is convex.
P is convex, Q is plane, R is concave.
All three must be plane mirrors because every image is erect.
Q is convex: a larger image always means a wider view.

teacher.key_rationale: Same-size erect image marks a plane mirror; a larger erect close-up marks concave; a smaller erect image marks convex.
teacher.figure_note: Three panels: P same-size erect, Q larger erect, R smaller erect.
